text.p: Former Italy goalkeeper Walter Zenga said on Monday he was leaving serie B side Padova for the United States and the New England Revolution in Boston.
The move links Zenga with former club team mate and stopper Alexei Lalas, who became the first American to play in serie A when he joined Padova in 1994.
He also joins former Italy players Roberto Donadoni and Giuseppe Galderisi in U.S. soccer.
Zenga, who spent 12 seasons with Internazionale and was capped 58 times by Italy, said he would leave Padova this month to start a two-year contract.
Zenga last represented Italy against Ireland in the U.S. Cup in June 1992.
